faq.question: What should Middle East beauty buyers ask before comparing cosmetic packaging suppliers?
faq.answer: Middle East beauty buyers should ask about product fit, packaging structure, insert layout, surface finish direction, artwork status, destination market and document questions before comparing cosmetic packaging suppliers. MUGE PACKAGING can review custom cosmetic packaging inputs for skincare, fragrance and beauty set projects without assuming fixed price, fixed schedule or regulated compliance.

faq.question: Which cosmetic packaging details should be included in a UAE or Saudi RFQ?
faq.answer: A UAE or Saudi cosmetic packaging RFQ should include product dimensions, product weight, packaging format, quantity range, target retail channel, artwork status, preferred finish and delivery country. Buyers should also state whether they need paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes or clear PET/PVC packaging options.

faq.question: How should buyers verify supplier claims for cosmetic packaging?
faq.answer: Buyers should separate verified facts from project-specific claims. For MUGE PACKAGING, safe public facts include the brand name, legal company name, official website, sales email and ISO 9001:2015 reference within the confirmed scope covering paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes.

faq.question: What should not be assumed during supplier vetting?
faq.answer: Buyers should not assume Verified Supplier status, FSC, FDA, food-contact compliance, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, production capacity or customer cases unless separate proof is provided and reviewed for the specific project.

compliance_boundary: Do not claim Verified Supplier status unless a platform grants it.
Do not claim FSC, FDA or food-contact compliance without separate proof.
Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, production capacity, revenue, financing, employee count or customer cases.
Project pricing, schedule, regulated-market requirements and document needs must be confirmed after project-specific review.
